summary: Enhance your cybersecurity skills with our Data Analytics for Cybersecurity Training Course. Learn to analyze data effectively to combat cyber threats.
lede: Cybersecurity data analytics helps security professionals use telemetry to support detection, investigation, response, and control improvement. Designed for SOC analysts, incident responders, and others who work with security evidence, the course covers checking log quality, correlating events, mapping activity to threat techniques, reconstructing incident timelines, and reporting risk through metrics and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who analyze security telemetry, investigate cyber events, manage security operations, or use evidence to guide information security decisions. It suits foundation-level learners with relevant operational exposure and intermediate practitioners who need a more structured analytics method.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with information technology, cybersecurity terminology, security incidents, or IT operations. A working understanding of authentication, endpoints, networks, or cloud services will help you engage with the exercises, but the course introduces the analytics concepts progressively. You will not need to build production machine-learning models or write complex code.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
